title: Write the note an instructor posts when a live class moves
description: Write the message an instructor posts in the cohort when a live class is moved or cancelled, plus a filled example for a Tuesday coding class moved to Thursday. Include the new time, where learners should look for the recording, and one line on what to do if they cannot join. Keep it under 150 words. The example cohort is fictional. Use only what is named on https://zedu.chat/. If a step is not on the public site, mark it needs confirmation. Do not say the AI replaces instructors. Do not mention Telex, Enterprise prices, or per-student fees. Deliver the full piece in the attachment.
rationale: Live classes are a reason a bootcamp moves to the paid plan. A clear moved-class note keeps learners in the cohort instead of back in side chats.
reviewBlocker: The task has no delivery waiting for review.
